content_html:
SEO pricing packages: the Standard AI SEO plan

SEO pricing packages built around one clear monthly price. The Standard AI SEO plan starts at ₹15,000* per month: everything in Basic, plus 300 backlink submissions every month and full Google Business Profile management. It runs as an ongoing monthly project, with its targets set for months 10 to 12.

Standard AI SEO plan price

PlanStarting price
Standard AI SEOFrom ₹15,000* per month

What the Standard AI SEO plan includes

What Standard adds to the Basic plan

  • 300 backlink submissions a month: Business and brand backlinks submitted across 300 relevant platforms every month, for authority and referral visibility.
  • Google Business Profile optimisation and management: Full optimisation and ongoing management of your Google Business Profile: categories, localised descriptions, review strategy, localised posts and complete profile management.

How the Standard plan works

  1. Start with an audit: We study your competitors and audit the site, then set up Search Console, submit the sitemap and clear indexing errors.
  2. Map 30 pages: Each of 30 target pages gets its own high-intent keyword, so no two pages compete.
  3. Optimise and publish: The 30 pages, FAQ sections and social profiles are optimised; blogs, premium platform posts and 600 social posts go out every month.
  4. Build links every month: 300 backlink submissions a month, on top of 150 verified business profile links.
  5. Manage your Google Business Profile: Ongoing profile management: categories, descriptions, review strategy and regular local posts.
  6. Work toward the targets: AEO, GEO, AIO and CXO work continues each month toward DA 70+, DR 70+ and a 40%+ AI Overview share by months 10 to 12.

Need more? See the Basic and Premium plans, or read about our SEO services in India.
plan_shared_html:
Also included in the Standard plan, as in Basic

  • Strategy and technical foundation: Comprehensive competitor analysis; Technical SEO assessment and fixes; Google Search Console setup and configuration; On-page SEO optimisation; Website content optimisation.
  • Brand authority and AI-driven content: 30 keyword mapping; 30 custom AI prompts; 30 FAQ sections; 30 website blogs; 30 webpages optimised; 30 premium platform publications; 20 social platform publications; 150 verified business profile links.
  • Advanced search optimisation (AEO, GEO, AIO and CXO): Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO); Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO); AI Optimisation (AIO); Conversational Experience Optimisation (CXO).
  • Local SEO and business visibility: Local SEO optimisation.
  • Social media optimisation: Platforms covered; Scope; Brand analysis.

Standard plan targets

TargetGoalWhat it means
Domain Authority70+Target a score of 70+ to strengthen overall ranking potential site-wide.
Domain Rating70+Build backlinks toward a Domain Rating of 70+ to boost competitive standing.
AI Overview40%+Appear in 40%+ of relevant AI-generated answers across platforms like ChatGPT and Gemini.

A monthly ongoing project, with the targets to be achieved in months 10 to 12 (M10–M12).

Extra services (charged separately)

These are not part of the Standard plan price and can be added on extra charges:

  • ORM (online reputation management): Monitoring and managing reviews, mentions and brand sentiment, with a response strategy for negative reviews and ongoing reputation tracking.
  • Digital PR: Media outreach for feature stories, expert quotes and brand mentions, press release drafting and distribution, and earned links from news outlets.
  • Premium backlinks: Niche-specific, higher DA/DR placements and custom outreach beyond the standard package.
  • Multi-language blogs: Blogs translated and localised for regional or global audiences, with native-language SEO.
  • International SEO: Local pages for each market, hreflang, geo-targeted content and region-specific keyword mapping.
  • Website development: Custom-scoped website development for your requirements.
  • WordPress and Next.js development: Complete websites: WordPress with a custom theme, SEO plugin and caching, or Next.js with server-side rendering and static generation. Both include SEO-ready product, service and location pages.
  • Social media marketing: Marketing across Facebook, Instagram, X, LinkedIn and YouTube.

What to do before you start

  1. Share Google access: Manager or admin access to Gmail, Google Business Profile, Search Console, Analytics, Tag Manager, Google Ads, Google Drive and YouTube.
  2. Share social and ads access: Facebook Page and Meta Ads Manager, Instagram and LinkedIn.
  3. Share website access: Website admin panel (CMS), web hosting account and DNS settings. Delays in access can delay the project.
  4. Send your brand assets: Text, images and brand material you own or have permission to use.
  5. Plan to change passwords at the end: Change any temporary passwords you shared once the contract ends.
